mentions.name: Blobcache
mentions.description: Blobcache is a content-addressed data store for holding application state and building end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) applications. Version 0.0.2 adds a git remote so Git data can be pushed to and fetched from Blobcache.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Blobcache is a content-addressed data store for holding application state, and buiding E2EE applications.
This most recent release includes a git remote so you can push and fetch Git data into and out of Blobcache.

mentions.name: Blobcache
mentions.description: Content-addressed storage available over the network, allowing nodes to securely produce and consume storage. Configuration works like SSH — drop a public key in the configuration and you're done — and it serves as a universal backend for end-to-end encrypted applications. GPL-licensed FOSS.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on Blobcache.  https://github.com/blobcache/blobcache

Blobcache is content addressed storage, available over the network.
Blobcache allow nodes to securely produce and consume storage.
Configuration in similar to SSH, drop a public key in the configuration, and you're done.
Blobcache is a universal backend for E2E encrypted applications.
